# find context dating

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:findContextDating`](gmeow-findContextDating.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/findContextDating>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/archaeological-evidence`](../../slices/archaeological-evidence.md)

The temporal measurement(s) assigned to a carrier's find context — radiocarbon, stratigraphic correlation, terminus post quem, etc. Non-functional: multiple dating methods and competing date claims coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
